text: Ha! Slow lander, fish on. Bring it in! That's not a song, that's a work order. I've heard that call on every deck from Ketchikan to Dutch Harbor.
Watch it splash, watch it slish. He's reaching for his gaff, and it's only a pink. A pink! The smallest fish in the sea, and it's giving him a sermon. I already know this man.
Four seasons with the captain. And the captain's his son. I know that walk. The son's the captain, but the dad taught him to be an Alaskan and a man.
Lead it 'round like a pet on a leash. That's not slow. That's a man moving at the ocean's pace. The fish isn't lost. It's being shown the room.
We are all watching and waiting. That's the whole song, right there. Nobody's helping. Everybody's watching. That's a witness's line.
And then it gets away! Oh well, other fish in the sea. Too bad for me, but for him he's free. He's not mad! He's free! I'm singing this one first.
